items.subject: The Colonial mine tailings dump above a red-earth gully, runoff carrying blue asbestos tailings downslope
items.action: thin sheets of rainwater run off the dump and pull the tailings into branching rivulets toward the gully
items.gaze_interaction: no human; the eye follows the rivulets from the dump down into the creek line
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge country, Pilbara, present day; abandoned mine dump on a spinifex slope, eroded channels below
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, rust brown, weathered grey, bluish-grey streaks of tailings, pale dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a fresh erosion channel cutting into the dump's foot, wet and glistening
items.camera_angle: high aerial angle looking down the slope
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide-angle lens
items.lighting: soft pale dawn light, low sun grazing wet surfaces
items.mood: still dawn air, water moving with no one near, vast empty slope, quiet spreading stain
items.narration_anchor: Los relaves del vertedero de Colonial se van con el agua.

items.subject: Gullies cut by water erosion leading away from the tailings dump, marked as the main source and pathway
items.action: the gullies fan outward, each one draining toward the lower creek beds
items.gaze_interaction: no human; focal line runs from a lone survey stake down the gully toward the plain
items.setting: eroded hillside below the Colonial dump, Wittenoom Gorge, present day, red rock and spinifex tussocks
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, dusty brown, grey rock, faint blue-grey sediment lines, clear dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a weathered timber survey stake with faded orange flagging tape at the gully head
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the gully head looking downstream
items.lighting: soft pale dawn light, long low shadows
items.mood: wind stirring the faded tape, empty slope, measured silence after the survey
items.narration_anchor: Un informe técnico lo marcó como la fuente principal y la vía del asbesto:

items.subject: Braided creek beds, shallow pools and floodplains running across red plain toward the Fortescue River
items.action: the creek channels wind and braid across the plain, pooling and spreading toward a distant line of river gums
items.gaze_interaction: no human; focal direction from foreground pools out to the river line on the horizon
items.setting: Fortescue catchment floodplain below the Hamersley Range, Pilbara, present day
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, sand beige, olive green river gums, mirror-blue pools, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a still pool reflecting the sky in the middle of a dry channel
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide-angle lens
items.lighting: soft pale dawn light, mist thinning over the floodplain
items.mood: immense quiet plain, low mist, the slow reach of water across the land
items.narration_anchor: la erosión, los lechos de arroyo, las pozas, las llanuras de inundación hacia el río Fortescue.

items.subject: Blue asbestos tailings left behind at the dried edge of a creek pool
items.action: the receding waterline has left the fibrous material settled into the cracked mud as it dries
items.gaze_interaction: no human; focus rests on the drying rim where water meets cracked earth
items.setting: drying rock pool in a creek bed downstream of Wittenoom, present day
items.color_palette: cracked red-brown mud, ochre sand, steely blue fibres, pale grey silt
items.props_detail: a curled flake of dried mud lifting at the pool's rim
items.camera_angle: low angle just above the ground
items.lens_technique: shallow depth of field, macro lens
items.lighting: soft pale dawn light, raking across the surface texture
items.mood: no wind, the water gone, a fine stain resting where it dried
items.narration_anchor: Fibras azules que el agua deja donde se seca.

items.subject: A sandy creek channel beyond the edge of the marked contamination zone, faint blue streaks in its bed
items.action: the channel carries on past a faded boundary post, blue-grey streaks continuing in the sand beyond it
items.gaze_interaction: no human; focal direction from the boundary post along the streaked channel into open country
items.setting: creek channel outside the Wittenoom contamination zone, Pilbara, 2021
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre sand, sun-bleached white post, blue-grey sediment streaks, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a leaning sun-bleached boundary marker post half buried in creek sand
items.lighting: soft pale dawn light, low sun from behind the post
items.mood: long shadow of the post across the sand, the streaks passing it untouched, open silence
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintiuno, una nota ambiental registró fibras en canales de arroyos fuera de la zona marcada como contaminada.

items.subject: The Fortescue River basin stretching to the horizon, river pools linked by dry channels
items.action: water lies motionless in the long river pools as the basin stretches away unchanged
items.gaze_interaction: no human; focal direction to the far horizon where the river line fades
items.setting: Fortescue River catchment, Pilbara, present day, river gums and red ranges
items.color_palette: red ranges, ochre plain, olive river gums, silver-blue pools, pale dawn sky
items.props_detail: a single dead river gum standing in a silted pool
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, telephoto compression of the distant ranges
items.lighting: soft pale dawn light, first sun touching the far ranges
items.mood: enormous unchanging land, slow light, time stretched beyond a lifetime
items.narration_anchor: El mismo informe advirtió que, sin intervención, el aporte de asbesto a la cuenca del Fortescue puede seguir durante cientos de años.

items.subject: An elderly Aboriginal Australian Banjima man, about seventy, thin frame, in faded work shirt and wide-brimmed hat, seated beside a middle-aged Latin American visitor of medium build in a plain shirt
items.action: the two men sit together on a rock outcrop above the creek country, talking quietly
items.gaze_interaction: both seen in three-quarter view from behind, looking out over the land; the elder's hand resting on his walking stick
items.setting: Banjima country, rock outcrop above a dry creek bed near Wittenoom Gorge, 2023
items.color_palette: red rock, ochre spinifex, dusty brown clothing, faded khaki, golden sky
items.props_detail: a worn wooden walking stick leaning against the elder's knee
items.camera_angle: eye-level from behind and slightly to the side
items.lighting: low golden late-afternoon light, warm rim on shoulders
items.mood: long shadows, the elder's shoulders slightly hunched, slow breathing posture, wide calm land ahead
items.narration_anchor: Es tierra Banjima. En dos mil veintitrés, Marcos Orellana visitó Australia y se sentó con Maitland Parker, un anciano Banjima.

items.subject: An elderly Aboriginal Australian Banjima man, about seventy, gaunt with hollowed cheeks and thin arms showing illness, red dust on his boots and trouser cuffs
items.action: he stands alone at the edge of a dry creek bed, refusing to step away from the land
items.gaze_interaction: face toward the camera, eyes wet and lowered slightly, one hand on his walking stick, the other resting flat over his chest
items.setting: dry creek bed on Banjima country near Wittenoom, red ranges behind, 2023
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, faded khaki shirt, grey stubble, golden light, faint blue streaks in the sand
items.props_detail: his worn wooden walking stick planted in the creek sand
items.lighting: low golden late-afternoon light, warm side light, long shadow behind him
items.mood: wind lifting his hat brim, shoulders drawn in, weight leaning on the stick, the land vast and quiet behind him
items.narration_anchor: «Todavía lloro por mi territorio, pero eso está arraigado en mí; simplemente no puedo alejarme de él», dijo Parker.

items.subject: A wide-brimmed felt hat and a walking stick left on a flat red rock beside the dry creek bed
items.action: the hat and stick rest untouched on the rock as evening wind moves through the spinifex
items.gaze_interaction: no human; focal direction from the empty rock out over the creek bed he watched
items.setting: the same creek-side rock on Banjima country near Wittenoom, 2024
items.color_palette: red rock, ochre spinifex, dusty brown felt, faded wood, amber sky
items.props_detail: the sun-faded felt hat with a band worn pale
items.lighting: low golden late-afternoon light fading toward dusk
items.mood: empty place where a man sat, dust settling, light sinking, stillness
items.narration_anchor: Maitland Parker murió de mesotelioma en dos mil veinticuatro.

items.subject: A folded newspaper front page announcing the Banjima legal action, lying on a dusty verandah rail
items.action: the newspaper rests on the rail, its edge stirring in the wind above the red plain
items.gaze_interaction: no human; focus on the headline with the empty creek country soft beyond
items.setting: weathered corrugated-iron verandah in the Pilbara, looking out to Banjima country
items.color_palette: newsprint grey, rusted iron, red dust, ochre plain, golden haze
items.props_detail: a red stone weighing down the newspaper
items.camera_angle: slightly high angle over the rail
items.mood: fine red dust on the paper, quiet wind, the land beyond still unchanged
items.narration_anchor: Dos años después, Gordon Legal presentó en nombre de BNTAC un proceso contra Australia Occidental en el Tribunal Federal.

items.subject: Permanent barricade blocking the road into the abandoned Wittenoom town, the deserted remains beyond
items.action: the barricade cuts the road while wind pushes red dust across the empty ground behind it
items.gaze_interaction: no human; focal direction past the barricade into the empty, decaying town
items.setting: former town entrance of Wittenoom, Pilbara, 2024, decaying corrugated-iron structures, tailings-surfaced ground
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, rust brown, weathered grey iron, faint blue tailings, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a heavy steel-and-concrete road barrier streaked with rust and red dust
items.lighting: overcast windy dawn, flat grey-gold light
items.mood: dust drifting over nothing, no tracks, no footprints, silence on the far side
items.narration_anchor: Nadie ha empezado a limpiar. En los accesos al pueblo y desfiladero hay bloqueos.

items.subject: Barricade across the gorge road with a government warning sign, the red gorge walls rising behind
items.action: the road ends at the barrier while wind sweeps red dust down the empty gorge
items.gaze_interaction: no human; focal direction up the closed road into the silent gorge
items.setting: entrance to Wittenoom Gorge, Pilbara, 2024, banded red rock walls and spinifex
items.color_palette: deep red rock, ochre, rust, sun-faded white and red sign, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a sun-faded steel warning sign bolted to the barrier
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide-angle lens
items.lighting: overcast windy dawn, flat grey-gold light
items.mood: towering walls, a closed road, wind and dust and nothing else
